name: SMHI open data hydrological observations (Sweden river flow)
short: Swedish river discharge every 15 minutes from SMHI's gauges, JSON, CSV or XML. CC BY 4.0, no key.
summary: The Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI) publishes hydrological observations through the Hydroobs open data service. Parameter 2 is discharge at 15-minute resolution (m3/s), with 721 stations listed, 299 flagged active on 2026-11-07. A keyless GET for station 2357 (Abisko, Torneälven catchment) with period latest-hour answered 200 on 2026-11-07 UTC with values 58.0 and 58.2 m3/s, the newest stamped 18:00 UTC, quality flag O. Other parameters include daily and monthly discharge, water temperature, and ice and snow items. The service nests parameter, station and period (latest-hour, latest-day, latest-months, corrected-archive) and returns JSON, XML, CSV or Atom.

tasks: latest river discharge (m3/s) at a Swedish gauge, 15-minute series
daily and monthly discharge, water temperature
station metadata with catchment name and size

coverage.notes: 721 stations listed for the 15-minute discharge parameter, 299 active. Water level (parameter 3) listed only 10 stations when checked, so this is mainly a discharge feed. Station names are Swedish; titles are in Swedish.

rate_limit.notes: No numeric limit was found on the pages read.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07 UTC: station 2357 latest-hour data, newest value 18:00 UTC; service index updated 18:00 UTC.

latency.typical: Within about an hour on one sample
latency.notes: Values are provisional (quality O) until corrected; the corrected-archive period holds the checked series.

freshness.typical_age: About 15 to 60 minutes on one sample
freshness.notes: The service index carries an updated timestamp. Inactive stations stop updating.

licensing.summary: SMHI open data carry Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (Swedish text: Erkännande 4.0 SE) under the terms of use page updated 2026-06-15: copy, distribute and adapt, including commercially, naming SMHI as the source and stating any change. Impact-based weather warnings have separate terms; they are not part of this feed. AI training is not addressed.

time.method: Each value has a millisecond epoch timestamp.
time.unknown: Timestamp is the measurement time as processed by SMHI.

location.method: Station latitude and longitude in the station record.

content.method: SMHI gauge data with a quality code per value (O = provisional per the service; code meaning not checked).
content.unknown: Values are flagged O in real time; the corrected-archive period holds checked series.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

auth.how_to_get: No key sent or needed in the calls made.

endpoints.notes: Call made. 15-minute discharge: station list with active flag and coordinates.
Call made (station 2357). Also latest-day, latest-months, corrected-archive; data.csv and data.xml.

api.rate_limits: Not stated on the pages read.
api.notes: JSON, XML, CSV or Atom by file extension.
